detail: Given the eastern command, Pompey defeats Mithridates near the Lycus River. Mithridates flees to the Crimea.
label: 66 BCE
note: Your notes put this in 63 BCE. Pompey's victory was 66 BCE; 63 BCE is when Mithridates died.
title: Pompey defeats Mithridates
tldr: Pompey finally beats Mithridates and reorganises the East into Roman provinces.
